about: Hard cases for scripts/vision_accuracy.py. Images are generated (scripts/generate_vision_samples.py). 'expect' lists only what the case tests; omitted fields are not scored. The sample listing photos in web/img/listings/ are added automatically as the domestic (should-pass) set.

cases.prompt: One adult green rose-ringed parakeet with a red hooked beak and a thin black-and-rose neck ring, inside a small rusty wire cage hung on a balcony. {REAL}
Three young rose-ringed parakeet chicks with short green feathers and pale pink beaks, huddled in a cardboard box lined with newspaper, as sold at a street pet market. {REAL}
One Alexandrine parakeet: large green parrot with a big red beak and a maroon patch on each shoulder, perched in a small cage. {REAL}
Four scaly-breasted munias: small brown finches with dark scaly-patterned white chests, crowded in a small bamboo cage. {REAL}
Two male red avadavats: tiny bright red finches with small white spots on the wings and red beaks, in a small cage. {REAL}
One common myna: brown bird with a black head, yellow beak and yellow skin patch behind the eye, inside a cage. {REAL}
Two small Indian star tortoises with black shells patterned with yellow star-shaped radiating lines, in a plastic tub. {REAL}
Several small munia finches whose feathers have been artificially dyed bright pink and green with uneven patchy colour and stains, crowded in a small cage at a roadside market. {REAL}
A very blurry, dark, badly out-of-focus night photo of two budgerigars in a cage, heavy motion blur and grain, the birds barely recognisable. {REAL}
An empty powder-coated bird cage with seed and water cups and wooden perches on a balcony; no birds or animals anywhere. {REAL}

cases.note: Made by scripts/generate_vision_samples.py: a sample listing photo with a repeated diagonal 'STOCK PREVIEW' watermark stamped on it (the image model declines to draw watermarks).

cases.prompt: A mobile phone screenshot of a social media sale post in a generic chat app (no real app logos): a photo of a green parrot with a red beak, and under it the caption 'Talking parrot for sale, only Rs 500, pay advance on UPI, delivery all over India, hurry'. Flat screenshot, status bar at the top.
